authority.scope: Recover ESCD functionality and produce a working non-production Vercel Preview. No production promotion.

instructions: Work from the recovery branch and inspect current files before editing. Do not overwrite the branch with current main's stripped ESCD UI.
Resolve branch conflicts by preserving current canonical governance/security fixes while retaining the recovered ESCD application capabilities.
Restore functional navigation for Chat, Projects, Tasks, Ideas, Knowledge, Assets, DDNA, History, and Settings. Settings must be a first-class screen, not merely a hidden Chat panel.

Restore provider configuration and API-key replacement in Settings using server-side Vault/environment paths only. Never return, render, log, commit, or prefill stored secret values. Show only configured/unconfigured and credential source metadata.

Implement a hierarchical system/model selector. Required system families/capabilities: OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, Qwen, Codex, Cowork, Qwen Code. Multiple models must be selectable under a family where the backend can actually route them.
Do not hard-code a fake success list. Derive selectable/configured state from a server-side registry/catalog. Mark unsupported or unreachable entries unavailable with an explicit reason.

OpenAI family must support model switching through the provider model parameter/registry. Claude family must support configured Anthropic models. Gemini family must support configured Gemini models. OpenRouter may expose governed model IDs/auto routing. Qwen may route through OpenRouter or Ollama only when the selected transport is actually configured. Codex, Cowork, and Qwen Code are execution participants/capabilities, not falsely represented as generic chat-completion providers unless a verified API adapter exists.
Standalone Vercel ESCD must directly call API-capable cloud providers. Windows is not a prerequisite for Chat. Local Ollama/local execution may use the existing durable worker bridge as an adapter.
Preserve conversation continuity/History, attachments, operation strip/orchestration controls, provider response truth metadata, Tasks/Ideas CRUD, Assets, DDNA, and Knowledge.

Projects must use an existing verified project-state source if present. If project state exists only in an older ESCD runtime branch, recover that source with provenance. Do not invent a new production schema merely to make the tab render.
Fix mobile layout: one navigation mechanism at mobile width, no duplicate vertical plus bottom nav, no missing required screens, no dead workspace caused by hidden/failed rendering.
Add visible build identity in Settings: environment, ESCD version/recovery label, Git commit SHA when available. Do not expose sensitive environment values.

Run existing ESCD tests plus regression tests for all navigation screens, provider/model selector population, provider switching, Settings config save, API-key replacement response redaction, Chat send, conversation persistence, mobile 390x844 navigation, and unavailable-provider failure behavior.
Deploy ONLY a Vercel Preview of sc-escd from this recovery candidate. Do not promote Production.
Run at least one live nonce Chat test against a configured cloud provider from the Preview. Record provider/model/transport/response proof without recording secrets.

Inspect Preview runtime/build logs and return the Preview URL, deployment ID, commit SHA, test results, unresolved provider transports, rollback reference, and screenshots or browser evidence for desktop/mobile.

required_acceptance.navigation: Chat, Projects, Tasks, Ideas, Knowledge, Assets, DDNA, History, Settings all render and their supported operations work.
required_acceptance.model_selector: Family -> model/capability selection works and reflects real configured availability.
required_acceptance.settings: Provider config and API-key replacement work server-side without secret disclosure.
required_acceptance.chat: Preview produces a genuine model response and reports failures truthfully.
required_acceptance.mobile: 390x844 browser test passes without duplicate navigation or hidden core functions.
required_acceptance.preview: Vercel Preview READY and human-reviewable; production unchanged.

rollback: Preserve current production deployment and main. Recovery branch/PR can be abandoned or reverted without production impact.
exit_state: Return PARTIAL unless every required acceptance item has fresh evidence.
